The '''1938–39 [[Primeira Liga|Primeira Divisão]]''' season was the fifth season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in [[Portugal]]. The competition was renamed '''Campeonato Nacional da Primeira Divisão''' (National Championship of the First Division) or '''Primeira Divisão''' for short.
